purpose: Compare each current canonical strategy implementation against the strongest available public rule provenance before any performance redesign.

evidence_policy.community_use: Rule-discovery and implementation-risk evidence only; never treated as proof of profitability.
evidence_policy.performance_claim_policy: No public performance claim is accepted without reproducible data, transaction costs, and strict-forward OOS.
evidence_policy.unknown_origin_policy: Do not invent an author or canonical rule set. Classify as GENERIC_PATTERN or ZEL_SYNTHETIC.
evidence_policy.upgrade_gate: No strategy mutation until source identity, role, timeframe, side, setup, trigger, invalidation, exit, sizing, and regime are all explicitly mapped.
